# 101conv

> 101conv is a private, self-hosted workspace for converting, compressing, assembling, inspecting, and automating files. The name is provisional.

This is a concise project index for search crawlers and assistant tools. It is
informational only; it is not an API, a deployment configuration, or a promise
that every deployment exposes every capability.

## Project

- Repository: https://github.com/Timisah/101conv
- Installation and deployment: https://github.com/Timisah/101conv#readme
- Public information page: /about/
- Project status and verified evidence: https://github.com/Timisah/101conv/blob/main/docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md

## Workspace areas

- Convert: submit supported files to installed, versioned conversion profiles.
- Compress: set quality or bounded size goals and inspect actual output savings.
- Build: order pages non-destructively, preview, and generate a raster-image PDF in the current first slice.
- Inspect: run an ephemeral, bounded metadata scan without adding the source to conversion storage.
- Automate: use registered mounted-folder blueprints with stable-file checks, history, and safe publication.

## Verified catalog scope

- Images: JPG/JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, GIF, and AVIF image profiles; JPEG XL paths cover JPG/JPEG, PNG/APNG, and GIF to JXL, plus JXL to JPG/JPEG/PNG.
- Audio/video: FFmpeg profiles cover MP4/MKV/MOV/AVI/WebM-family video and MP3/AAC/M4A/OGG/OPUS/WAV/FLAC/WMA/AMR audio, with separate conversion and compression paths.
- Documents: DOCX/DOC/ODT/XLSX/XLS/ODS/PPTX/PPT/ODP/RTF/TXT to PDF; PDF to PNG/JPG/JPEG or TXT through managed document profiles on supported Linux AMD64 deployments.
- Catalog rules and provenance: https://github.com/Timisah/101conv/blob/main/docs/profiles/catalog-format.md

## Important limits

- A deployment exposes only the engines and profiles its administrator installs.
- Format pairs, animation behavior, metadata mapping, HDR preservation, and exact target-size results are profile- and engine-specific; no universal fidelity guarantee is made.
- PDF rendering produces one selected page; this release does not provide OCR or editable Office export.
- The public page is informational. There is no anonymous public conversion demo selected by this project index.
